mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact equilibrium contraction constants, wall energy/gravity and moving-boundary derivatives, full radial Euler-Poisson identity, trace/Hardy kernel, strict assigned-scale wall-root/gate/coercivity bounds.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact rational and symbolic real arithmetic; pi<4 upper bounds; no sampled ODE used as proof.
mathematics.conventions: Newtonian rest-mass Poisson gravity includes neutral mass, prescribed central mass and wall rest mass. Gauge/internal/kinetic energy gravity omitted. Central charge/mass fixed; neutral mass and total charge conserved; Γ6/5 EOS and moving positive-density boundary.

bounds.input_family: One explicitly assigned finite-ball parameter set, with analytic open strict-margin conditions.
bounds.resources: 45 seconds wall,35 CPU seconds,one cooperative numerical-library thread
bounds.computational_scope: Symbolic identities and rational inequalities only; no numerical shooting or spectrum

non_claims: No nonspherical interface, magnetic-background, nonlinear PDE or Einstein analysis.
No wall/EOS microphysics, production, abundance or empirical gate.
Finite exact checks audit proof constants, not an automatic global theory certificate.
